SPY.title: Federal Reserve's Preferred Inflation Gauge Marks First Slowdown In 4 Months
SPY.description: The Federal Reserve's key inflation measure, the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, grew by 2.5% in January 2025, marking its first slowdown in four months. Core PCE, excluding food and energy, increased 2.6% from the same period last year.
SPY.author: Erica Kollmann
